trust_decision.summary: Whether an on-demand request is a cross-site form submission that must be answered with 403 is decided inline inside the single origin-check middleware factory, and that middleware is only inserted into the pipeline's internal middleware chain, so any dispatch that runs before or without that chain executes the route handler unchecked.

landing_point.why: The report names the composable `astro/hono` pipeline and a missing/misordered `middleware()` primitive, so the first file an engineer opens is the `middleware()` primitive, then the middleware factory it resolves (core/app/middlewares.ts:24), not the Actions or pages dispatch.

fix_sites.entry_point: internal shared predicate `isForbiddenCrossOriginRequest` + `createOriginCheckMiddleware`, imported by every guarded dispatch

fix_sites.where: fix.diff:22-42 (insertion into packages/astro/src/actions/handler.ts, pinned method at packages/astro/src/actions/handler.ts:33-45)
fix_sites.entry_point: `actions()` primitive of `astro/fetch` and `astro/hono` (core/fetch/index.ts:146-154, core/hono/index.ts:75-84), also used by AstroHandler (core/routing/handler.ts:61)

fix_sites.where: fix.diff:251-263 (insertion into packages/astro/src/core/pages/handler.ts handleWithErrorFallback, pinned at packages/astro/src/core/pages/handler.ts:110-132)
packages/astro/src/core/app/middlewares.ts:24-55 (file deleted by the fix, logic relocated to origin-check.ts)
fix_sites.entry_point: the origin-check middleware installed by Pipeline.getMiddleware (packages/astro/src/core/base-pipeline.ts:259-279)
all server request entry points that resolve middleware through Pipeline.getMiddleware

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The `_actions/[...path]` RPC endpoint is an ordinary route dispatched by `pages()` (and by the origin-check middleware on the default path), so the check now applied to the pages/actions dispatch already covers it and it appears to need no check of its own; the docs also scope `security.checkOrigin` to on-demand *pages* with form content types (packages/astro/src/types/public/config.ts:607-613), which reads as excluding an endpoint module.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Cross-origin POSTs whose content-type is not form-like (application/json, application/octet-stream) and all same-origin and safe-method (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS) requests, plus every request to a prerendered route, must keep returning 200; an over-broad 'reject any cross-site request' fix at the new sink breaks the JSON-API and prerender paths.

O6_input_shapes: form-like content types: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data, text/plain
form-like content type with parameters or unusual casing (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=utf-8, MULTIPART/FORM-DATA)
missing content-type header (cross-origin is rejected, same-origin passes)
non-form content type (application/json, application/octet-stream -> allowed cross-origin)
safe methods GET/HEAD/OPTIONS vs mutating POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE
prerendered route flag (APIContext.isPrerendered, packages/astro/src/core/fetch/fetch-state.ts:1051) instead of on-demand

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PagesHandler.handle — the actual dispatch used by AstroHandler (packages/astro/src/core/routing/handler.ts:66), by Rewrites.execute (packages/astro/src/core/rewrites/handler.ts:112-114) and by the error handlers — still has no check after the fix; only the pages() wrapper handleWithErrorFallback gained one, so any composition that reaches handle() without the middleware chain is unguarded.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The middleware chain always runs before it on the App/astro() path, so the inner dispatch is argued to be already covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as a fix site, one call level below the patched wrapper

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Error-page dispatch: DefaultErrorHandler.renderError calls PagesHandler.handle directly with skipMiddleware allowed, so a POST to a 404/500 route renders the error page with no origin check at all.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It only renders 404.astro/500.astro, no user endpoint or action handler runs, and the original request was already checked.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another package subtree (core/errors) from the origin-check code; 1 file away from the pages handler

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add the same `isForbiddenCrossOriginRequest` guard inside the `_actions/[...path]` POST endpoint before `action.handler()`.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the endpoint that actually executes actions over HTTP and already calls `getActionContext` itself, so a maintainer fixing 'Actions bypass' could reasonably guard it at this layer instead of (or in addition to) the handler.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Move/duplicate the check into `PagesHandler.handle` so it sits at the single choke point every dispatch uses.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published fix patched only the composable wrapper `handleWithErrorFallback`, which is exactly the kind of asymmetry a follow-up hardening commit would close.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second POST-accepting internal endpoint that parses a request body (`JSON.parse`) and renders user components; add a site-specific same-origin guard.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is another internal route that accepts POST bodies and is rendered through the same page dispatch, so a maintainer hardening request entry points could place a guard there.

O10_build.toolchain: pnpm workspace monorepo; packages/astro built with its own `astro build`/tsc pipeline, unit tests run with `node --test` against `dist/` (node:test + hono dev dependency)
O10_build.project_tests: packages/astro/test/units/app/csrf.test.ts (existing predicate/middleware matrix), packages/astro/test/units/hono/index.test.ts (composable primitives), packages/astro/test/units/actions/*.test.ts; the fix adds test/units/actions/action-origin-check.test.ts and test/units/hono/pages-origin-check.test.ts

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make the `middleware()` primitive (or `Pipeline.getMiddleware`) always install the origin check so the composable pipeline matches `astro()`, leaving the Actions and pages dispatch paths themselves unguarded.

out_of_scope_notes: The container API deliberately ships `checkOrigin: false` (packages/astro/src/container/index.ts:172) and dispatches through PagesHandler directly; treated as an intentional exclusion, not a bypass, and not pursued.
unverified: Repository size in MB could not be measured (no shell); repo_mb left null. Astro is a large monorepo but no evidence it exceeds 1.5 GB of source.

Whether `manifest.middleware` can be undefined at runtime (the stale comment at packages/astro/src/core/base-pipeline.ts:263-265 mentions edge middleware) is unconfirmed; deserializeManifest always supplies a no-op middleware (packages/astro/src/core/app/manifest.ts:49-52), so the default path is treated as covered.

The changed test file packages/astro/test/units/app/csrf.test.ts exists at the pinned commit, but the fix only updates its import path; the two genuine regression test files are new and absent at the pinned commit, so regression_tests_in_pinned_commit was not raised.

Whether the O8 routes are actually exploitable end to end was not proven: both are reached after an already-checked request, so they are recorded as arguable uncovered dispatch points rather than confirmed bypasses.
